history.summary: Add independent Project Evolution ledger alongside application and companion guide, preserve decisions, gaps and review history.

Each placed device already has editable name; cable gets explicit editable name. Duplicate selected device with fresh device/port identifiers or duplicate cable with fresh cable identifier; device duplication does not copy cables. UI button inside Properties.
Direct/broken choice, touch waypoints, live multi-segment preview, persistence in cable.waypoints, termination only at device port.
Fix mobile cable port hit-testing via SVG screen coordinate transforms, 60px magnetic snap, eliminate duplicate waypoint event registration.
Persistent visible broken cable during multi-tap entry, stable solid bends and active dashed segment; draft remains across finger release.
Two-finger pinch zoom around midpoint plus midpoint panning. Suspend single-finger manipulation while multi-touch active.
Always-visible live zoom percentage badge, including pinch updates.
Pan canvas in Select mode by dragging blank area with one finger; pan deltas corrected via SVG screen scale; device dragging and two-finger pinch remain available.
Add 14px pinch activation threshold to avoid unintended zoom while translating with two fingers.
Double tap empty canvas to zoom 1.25x around tap midpoint, separate from device double tap.
Double-tap blank canvas multiplier 1.25x → 1.5x.
Copy/Delete moved to top of device and cable property sheets, Save remains at bottom.
SVG nested port event classification fixed; empty canvas double-tap moved to tap-release gesture rather than pointer down; moving canvas cannot trigger zoom gesture.
Geometry-based device hit-testing, stable zoom-aware device movement. Regression reported against V23 but default branch confirmed V21.
Click zoom percentage badge to reset to 100%, and reset viewport automatically when creating a new drawing.
Clear stale touch tracking at duplicate and primary touch; clean on capture loss/blur; enforce pointer identity for drag. Repeated failure after V23 recorded, runtime fix awaiting testing.

analyses.title: Rendering strategy
analyses.assessment: Use a reusable semantic document model independent of rendering package. Evaluate JointJS Community and Konva.js against connection, routing, render, React embeddability and license before changing core architecture.

analyses.title: Interface taxonomy
analyses.assessment: Separate communication type, connector type, physical cable type, and device port. Port has stable identity, display color, placement side and attachment capacity. RS-485 is an interface, not a connector.

analyses.title: Documents and history
analyses.assessment: Each portable document holds current drawing and all revision snapshots in JSON. Names are not identity, documentId is stable. Restore must append new revision. Local Browser Storage is not shared server storage.

analyses.title: Offline vs shared persistence
analyses.assessment: GitHub Pages serves read-only static app; direct file writes require server API on IIS. Do not add this backend until migration is requested. Admin-only deletion must be implemented server-side.

analyses.title: Vector symbols security
analyses.assessment: SVG only; sanitize against scripts, event handlers, external references, foreignObject and risky URLs. Bitmap wrapping is not vectorization. True raster-to-vector is future feature and must be assessed for reliability.

analyses.title: Mobile touch fidelity
analyses.assessment: Two-stage category/device picker, double tap for Properties, dragging object, drag-to-connect with snap near ports, PWA/mobile Safari tests. Test on iPhone; syntax validation does not establish gesture correctness.

analyses.title: GitHub Pages cache/version
analyses.assessment: User saw stale v0.4 after deployments; cache-busting URL and UI version must be updated with each code release. GitHub Pages build/deploy latency remains.
